title: Moen S115BN Waterhill Vessel Extension Kit, Brushed Nickel

comparisons.notes: Same model S115BN Brushed Nickel; special order, ships in 6-10 weeks

amazon_match_notes: Woot offer data ASIN; Amazon listing is Moen S115BN Waterhill Extension Kit, Brushed Nickel, same model
writeup: Moen's S115BN Waterhill vessel extension kit in Brushed Nickel is $98.99 at Woot. Moen has discontinued it, and Ferguson charges $199.31 as a special order that ships in 6 to 10 weeks, so this is about half the price. It adds 3-inch extensions and a grid drain for Waterhill vessel faucets.
